product_overview: A backend ERP platform that provides JWT-based authentication, security administration, organization master data, master-data lookups, file token workflows, and notification services. It supports role-based access control, hierarchical org structures, and secure cross-module integrations.
core_goals: Provide secure authentication, token refresh, logout, signup, activation, and password recovery flows
Enable admin management of users, roles, permissions, and page-permission matrices
Support branch-scoped user profiles and role data-scope assignments
Manage organization master data including legal entities, branches, regions, departments, cost centers, profit centers, and location sites
Provide reusable master data lookup catalogs for dropdown consumption across modules
Support secure token-gated file upload, download, listing, and deletion workflows
Deliver notifications, templates, channel configs, and inbox/history capabilities

features.name: Authentication and Self-Service Account Recovery
features.description: Handles login, alternate login flow, token refresh, logout, self-signup, account activation, and password recovery for anonymous and authenticated users.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid username and password -> Receive 200 with accessToken and expiresIn -> Use the bearer token on a protected endpoint -> Receive 200 from the protected endpoint
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 or validation error response with success=false and error details
POST /api/auth/refresh with a valid refresh-token cookie -> Receive 200 with a new accessToken and expiresIn -> Continue calling protected endpoints
POST /api/auth/logout with a valid authenticated session -> Receive 204 No Content -> Reusing the old refresh token on POST /api/auth/refresh fails

POST /api/auth/signup with unique username, email, and password -> Receive 200 with signup confirmation and disabled account -> POST /api/auth/signup/activate with a valid token -> Receive 200 OK and enabled account
POST /api/auth/signup with duplicate username or duplicate email -> Receive error response with conflict or validation details
POST /api/auth/forgot-password with any email value -> Receive 200 generic OK response -> POST /api/auth/reset-password with an invalid or expired token -> Receive error response
POST /api/auth/reset-password with a valid token and new password -> Receive 200 OK -> POST /api/auth/login with the new password -> Receive 200 with accessToken

features.name: Users
features.description: Creates, lists, searches, updates, deletes, and assigns roles to user accounts for administrative management.
user_flows: GET /api/users with a valid JWT bearer token -> Receive 200 with paginated user list
POST /api/users with valid username and password -> Receive 200 with created user -> GET /api/users/{userId}/roles returns assigned roles
POST /api/users/search with search filters -> Receive 200 with paginated matching users
PUT /api/users/{userId} with updated user fields -> Receive 200 with updated user record
PUT /api/users/{userId}/roles with a full replacement role list -> Receive 200 with updated user roles -> GET /api/users/{userId}/roles reflects the replacement
DELETE /api/users/{userId} when active related sessions or child relations exist -> Receive error response with delete failure details
POST /api/users with duplicate username -> Receive error response with conflict details

features.name: Roles and Permission Matrix
features.description: Manages role CRUD, activation, deactivation, page-to-role permission assignments, matrix sync, and permission copying between roles.
user_flows: POST /api/roles with valid roleCode, roleName, and description -> Receive 200 with created role -> GET /api/roles/{roleId} returns the same role
POST /api/roles/search with roleName filter -> Receive 200 with paginated matching roles
PUT /api/roles/{roleId} with updated roleName or description -> Receive 200 with updated role while roleCode remains immutable
GET /api/roles/{roleId}/pages -> Receive 200 with the role's page-permission matrix
POST /api/roles/{roleId}/pages with pageCode and CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE permissions -> Receive 200 with assignment response -> GET /api/roles/{roleId}/pages shows VIEW auto-added
PUT /api/roles/{roleId}/pages with a full replacement matrix -> Receive 200 with the matrix replaced
POST /api/roles/{roleId}/copy-from/{sourceRoleId} -> Receive 200 with copied page-scoped permissions -> GET /api/roles/{roleId}/pages reflects the copied data
PUT /api/roles/{roleId}/activate -> Receive 200 with active role -> PUT /api/roles/{roleId}/deactivate -> Receive 200 with inactive role
DELETE /api/roles/{roleId} for a role still assigned to users -> Receive 409 conflict with role-in-use details
POST /api/roles with duplicate roleCode or invalid payload -> Receive error response with validation or conflict details

features.name: Permissions
features.description: Creates and updates granular permissions tied to pages and permission types.
user_flows: POST /api/permissions with valid name, pageId, and permissionType -> Receive 200 with created permission -> Use the returned permission in role-page flows
POST /api/permissions/search with name or module filters -> Receive 200 with paginated permission results
PUT /api/permissions/{id} with valid updates -> Receive 200 with updated permission
POST /api/permissions with an invalid pageId or duplicate name -> Receive error response with validation or conflict details
PUT /api/permissions/{id} for a non-existent permission -> Receive error response with not-found or validation details

features.name: Pages
features.description: Manages application pages and automatically generates CRUD permissions for each new page, with lifecycle activation controls.
user_flows: POST /api/pages with valid pageCode, names, route, and active=true -> Receive 200 with created page -> Verify the page's VIEW, CREATE, UPDATE, and DELETE permissions are generated
POST /api/pages/search with pageCode, name, module, or active filters -> Receive 200 with paginated page results
GET /api/pages/active with a valid JWT bearer token -> Receive 200 with active pages for dropdown use
PUT /api/pages/{id} with updated metadata and unchanged pageCode -> Receive 200 with updated page
PUT /api/pages/{id}/deactivate on an active page -> Receive 200 with deactivated page -> PUT /api/pages/{id}/reactivate -> Receive 200 with reactivated page
POST /api/pages with missing required fields or duplicate pageCode -> Receive error response with validation or conflict details

features.name: Role Branch Scoping
features.description: Assigns branch-level data access scopes to roles, supporting create, search, update, fetch, and delete operations for branch assignments.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/security/role-branches with valid roleIdFk, branchIdFk, and dataAccessLevel -> Receive 200 with SecRoleBranchDto
GET /api/v1/security/role-branches -> Receive 200 with paginated role-branch assignments
POST /api/v1/security/role-branches/search with role or branch criteria -> Receive 200 with paginated search results
GET /api/v1/security/role-branches/{roleId}/{branchId} -> Receive 200 with the matching role-branch assignment
PUT /api/v1/security/role-branches/{roleId}/{branchId} with updated dataAccessLevel -> Receive 200 with updated assignment
DELETE /api/v1/security/role-branches/{roleId}/{branchId} -> Receive 204 No Content
POST /api/v1/security/role-branches with duplicate roleIdFk and branchIdFk -> Receive error response with conflict details

features.name: User Profiles
features.description: Stores extended user profile information such as names, preferred language, branch assignment, and employee linkage.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/security/user-profiles with valid userIdFk and branchIdFk -> Receive 200 with SecUserProfileDto
GET /api/v1/security/user-profiles -> Receive 200 with paginated user profiles
POST /api/v1/security/user-profiles/search with branch or name filters -> Receive 200 with paginated profile results
GET /api/v1/security/user-profiles/{userId} -> Receive 200 with SecUserProfileDto for the user
PUT /api/v1/security/user-profiles/{userId} with updated names, language, or employee link -> Receive 200 with updated SecUserProfileDto
POST /api/v1/security/user-profiles with an unknown userIdFk or inactive branchIdFk -> Receive error response with validation or lookup failure details

features.name: Organization - Legal Entities
features.description: Manages top-level legal entities with create, search, lookup, update, and activation lifecycle controls.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/org/legal-entities with valid nameAr, nameEn, entityTypeId, and notes -> Receive 200 with LegalEntityResponse
GET /api/v1/org/legal-entities/{id} -> Receive 200 with LegalEntityResponse
POST /api/v1/org/legal-entities/search with name or active filters -> Receive 200 with paginated legal entity results
PUT /api/v1/org/legal-entities/{id} with updated names or notes -> Receive 200 with updated LegalEntityResponse
PUT /api/v1/org/legal-entities/{id}/activate -> Receive 200 with active LegalEntityResponse
PUT /api/v1/org/legal-entities/{id}/deactivate when active branches or profit centers exist -> Receive error response with business-rule rejection

features.name: Organization - Branches
features.description: Manages branches under legal entities with create, search, lookup, update, and activation lifecycle controls.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/org/branches with valid legalEntityFk, nameAr, nameEn, branchTypeId, and notes -> Receive 200 with BranchResponse
GET /api/v1/org/branches/{id} -> Receive 200 with BranchResponse
POST /api/v1/org/branches/search with legal entity or active filters -> Receive 200 with paginated branch results
PUT /api/v1/org/branches/{id} with updated branch fields -> Receive 200 with updated BranchResponse
PUT /api/v1/org/branches/{id}/activate -> Receive 200 with active BranchResponse
PUT /api/v1/org/branches/{id}/deactivate when dependent departments, cost centers, or location sites exist -> Receive error response with business-rule rejection

features.name: Organization - Regions
features.description: Manages regions under legal entities with region-type classification and activation lifecycle controls.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/org/regions with valid legalEntityFk, regionTypeIdFk, nameAr, nameEn, and notes -> Receive 200 with RegionResponse
GET /api/v1/org/regions/{id} -> Receive 200 with RegionResponse including the persisted region type
POST /api/v1/org/regions/search with legal entity or active filters -> Receive 200 with paginated region results
PUT /api/v1/org/regions/{id} with updated attributes -> Receive 200 with updated RegionResponse
PUT /api/v1/org/regions/{id}/activate -> Receive 200 with active RegionResponse
PUT /api/v1/org/regions/{id}/deactivate when active branches reference the region -> Receive error response with business-rule rejection
POST /api/v1/org/regions with invalid or missing regionTypeIdFk -> Receive error response with validation or lookup details

features.name: Organization - Departments
features.description: Manages hierarchical departments within a branch, including tree retrieval and activation lifecycle controls.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/org/departments with valid branchFk, names, parentDepartmentFk, nodeTypeId, and notes -> Receive 200 with DepartmentResponse
GET /api/v1/org/departments/{id} -> Receive 200 with DepartmentResponse
POST /api/v1/org/departments/search with branch or active filters -> Receive 200 with paginated department results
GET /api/v1/org/departments/tree with branchFk and isActiveFl -> Receive 200 with DepartmentTreeNodeResponse[]
PUT /api/v1/org/departments/{id} with updated hierarchy or names -> Receive 200 with updated DepartmentResponse
PUT /api/v1/org/departments/{id}/activate -> Receive 200 with active DepartmentResponse
PUT /api/v1/org/departments/{id}/deactivate -> Receive 200 with deactivated DepartmentResponse reflected on subsequent GET/search
PUT /api/v1/org/departments/{id}/deactivate when child departments still exist -> Receive error response with business-rule rejection
POST /api/v1/org/departments with a circular parentDepartmentFk reference -> Receive error response with validation or hierarchy details

features.name: Organization - Cost Centers

user_flows: POST /api/v1/org/cost-centers with valid branchFk, names, parentCostCenterFk, nodeTypeId, costCenterTypeId, and notes -> Receive 200 with CostCenterResponse
GET /api/v1/org/cost-centers/{id} -> Receive 200 with CostCenterResponse
POST /api/v1/org/cost-centers/search with branch or type filters -> Receive 200 with paginated cost center results
GET /api/v1/org/cost-centers/tree with branchFk and isActiveFl -> Receive 200 with CostCenterTreeNodeResponse[]
PUT /api/v1/org/cost-centers/{id} with updated hierarchy or classification -> Receive 200 with updated CostCenterResponse
PUT /api/v1/org/cost-centers/{id}/activate -> Receive 200 with active CostCenterResponse
PUT /api/v1/org/cost-centers/{id}/deactivate when dependent child cost centers exist -> Receive error response with business-rule rejection
POST /api/v1/org/cost-centers with a circular parentCostCenterFk reference -> Receive error response with validation or hierarchy details

features.name: Organization - Profit Centers
features.description: Manages profit centers under legal entities with create, search, lookup, update, and activation lifecycle controls.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/org/profit-centers with valid legalEntityFk, nameAr, nameEn, and notes -> Receive 200 with ProfitCenterResponse
GET /api/v1/org/profit-centers/{id} -> Receive 200 with ProfitCenterResponse
POST /api/v1/org/profit-centers/search with legal entity or active filters -> Receive 200 with paginated profit center results
PUT /api/v1/org/profit-centers/{id} with updated values -> Receive 200 with updated ProfitCenterResponse
PUT /api/v1/org/profit-centers/{id}/activate -> Receive 200 with active ProfitCenterResponse
PUT /api/v1/org/profit-centers/{id}/deactivate on an in-use center -> Receive error response with business-rule rejection

features.name: Organization - Location Sites
features.description: Manages physical location sites within branches with create, search, lookup, update, and activation lifecycle controls.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/org/location-sites with valid branchFk, nameAr, nameEn, siteTypeId, and notes -> Receive 200 with LocationSiteResponse
GET /api/v1/org/location-sites/{id} -> Receive 200 with LocationSiteResponse
POST /api/v1/org/location-sites/search with branch or active filters -> Receive 200 with paginated location site results
PUT /api/v1/org/location-sites/{id} with updated site data -> Receive 200 with updated LocationSiteResponse
PUT /api/v1/org/location-sites/{id}/activate -> Receive 200 with active LocationSiteResponse
PUT /api/v1/org/location-sites/{id}/deactivate when dependent branch references exist -> Receive error response with business-rule rejection

features.name: Master Data Lookups
features.description: Provides reusable master lookup catalogs and detail rows for dropdown consumption across modules, with cached read access for active values.
user_flows: GET /api/lookups/{lookupCode} with a valid lookup code -> Receive 200 with active lookup values for dropdown consumption
POST /api/masterdata/master-lookups with valid lookupKey, lookupName, lookupNameEn, description, and isActive -> Receive 200 with MasterLookupResponse
POST /api/masterdata/master-lookups/details with valid masterLookupId, code, names, sortOrder, and isActive -> Receive 200 with LookupDetailResponse
POST /api/masterdata/master-lookups/search with lookupKey or lookupName filters -> Receive 200 with paginated master lookup results
POST /api/masterdata/master-lookups/details/search with master lookup and code filters -> Receive 200 with paginated lookup detail results
PUT /api/masterdata/master-lookups/{id} with updated metadata -> Receive 200 with updated MasterLookupResponse
PUT /api/masterdata/master-lookups/details/{id} with updated detail metadata -> Receive 200 with updated LookupDetailResponse
PUT /api/masterdata/master-lookups/{id}/toggle-active with active=false -> Receive 200 with updated MasterLookupResponse
PUT /api/masterdata/master-lookups/details/{id}/toggle-active with active=false -> Receive 200 with updated LookupDetailResponse
DELETE /api/masterdata/master-lookups/{id} when detail rows exist -> Receive 409 conflict with has-details details
DELETE /api/masterdata/master-lookups/details/{id} when referenced elsewhere -> Receive 409 conflict with referenced details
POST /api/masterdata/master-lookups with duplicate lookupKey or invalid payload -> Receive error response with validation or conflict details

features.name: File Management
features.description: Issues encrypted upload and access tokens for secure upload, download, deletion, and owner-scoped listing of files.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/files/upload-token with valid ownerId, ownerType, moduleCode, and fileCategoryFk -> Receive 200 with encryptedToken and expiresAt -> POST /upload/{encryptedToken} with multipart file bytes -> Receive 200 with fileDocumentPk and file metadata
POST /api/v1/files/{fileDocumentPk}/access-token with a valid JWT token -> Receive 200 with encryptedToken and expiresAt -> GET /download/{encryptedToken} -> Receive binary file bytes

POST /api/v1/files/{fileDocumentPk}/access-token with a valid JWT token and delete action -> Receive 200 with encryptedToken and expiresAt -> DELETE /{encryptedToken} -> Receive 200 with file delete confirmation
GET /api/v1/files/{ownerId} with ownerType, page, and size parameters -> Receive 200 with paginated file summaries
POST /upload/{encryptedToken} with an expired, tampered, or wrong-action token -> Receive error response from token validation
GET /download/{encryptedToken} after the token expires -> Receive error response or no file bytes
DELETE /{encryptedToken} with a reused or mismatched token -> Receive error response or rejected request
POST /api/v1/files/upload-token with missing owner or fileCategory data -> Receive error response with validation details

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Sends immediate or scheduled notifications, manages templates and channel configurations, and exposes inbox/history endpoints for tracking and read-state updates.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/notifications/send with valid recipientId, channelHint, templateCode, contextData, priority, moduleCode, referenceId, and referenceType -> Receive 200 with NotificationSendConfirmation
POST /api/v1/notifications/schedule with valid future scheduledAt and notification payload -> Receive 200 with NotificationSendConfirmation
GET /api/v1/notifications/channel-configs with a valid JWT bearer token -> Receive 200 with channel configuration list
PUT /api/v1/notifications/channel-configs/{id} with updated enablement or configJson -> Receive 200 with updated NotificationChannelConfigResponse
POST /api/v1/notifications/templates with valid bilingual template fields -> Receive 200 with NotificationTemplateResponse
POST /api/v1/notifications/templates/search with module or templateCode filters -> Receive 200 with paginated template results
GET /api/v1/notifications/templates/{id} -> Receive 200 with NotificationTemplateResponse
PUT /api/v1/notifications/templates/{id} with updated bilingual body -> Receive 200 with updated NotificationTemplateResponse
PUT /api/v1/notifications/templates/{id}/deactivate -> Receive 200 with deactivated NotificationTemplateResponse
GET /api/v1/notifications/unread -> Receive 200 with unread notification summary
PUT /api/v1/notifications/{id}/read -> Receive 200 with notification read confirmation
POST /api/v1/notifications/history/search with recipient or module filters -> Receive 200 with paginated notification history
POST /api/v1/notifications/send with a disabled channel or invalid templateCode -> Receive error response or logged channel failure behavior
POST /api/v1/notifications/schedule with scheduledAt in the future -> Receive 200 even if dispatch behavior is implementation-limited

known_limitations.issue: Organization module (Legal Entities, Branches, Regions, Departments, Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Location Sites) is the primary focus of this run
known_limitations.impact: Frontend testing on 2026-08-29 found two suspected backend contract bugs here - a Region's regionTypeId not round-tripping through create/search response (TC010), and a Department's isActive state not flipping after PUT /deactivate (TC017) - prioritize verifying these two endpoints directly.

known_limitations.issue: Permissions search + module filter combo returns zero results
known_limitations.impact: Searching POST /api/permissions/search with both a text query and a module filter returns no results even for known permissions.
